adminUnits_description: Every house in the complex, its block and number, together with how many occupants are active right now. A unit is never deleted, only deactivated.
adminUnits_invalidForm: Invalid request: block and number are required.
adminUnits_forbidden: You are not allowed to manage units.
profile_subheading: Update your own name and phone number.
profile_phoneHint: Leave blank if you do not want to give a phone number yet.
profile_noRecordBody: Your account is not linked to any resident record in this complex yet. Contact the management to be registered to your unit.
profile_notifications_subheading: Choose which emails you want to receive. Some notification kinds cannot be turned off.
profile_notifications_kind_invoiceIssued: Email when your unit's monthly invoice is issued.
profile_notifications_kind_paymentVerifi: Email when a payment you sent has been verified by the management.
profile_notifications_kind_ownComplaintS: Email when the status of a complaint you filed changes.
profile_notifications_kind_monthlyReport: Email when the complex's monthly financial report is published.
profile_notifications_kind_newPost_descr: Email when a new announcement or activity is posted on the board.
adminOccupancies_heading: Occupancy history of unit block {block} number {number}
adminOccupancies_description: Who lived in this house over which stretch of time, and who is responsible for its invoices. An occupancy is never deleted, only ended.
adminOccupancies_empty: No occupancy has been recorded for this unit yet.
adminOccupancies_noResidents: No resident has been recorded yet, so there is nobody to attach to this unit.
adminOccupancies_setPrimarySuccess: The unit's primary occupant was set.
adminOccupancies_conflict: This unit already has a primary occupant over those days: {resident}, since {startedOn}. End that occupancy first.
adminOccupancies_dateOrder: The end date {endedOn} is earlier than the start date {startedOn}.
adminOccupancies_invalidForm: Invalid request: resident, occupancy role and start date are all required and must be well formed.
adminOccupancies_invalidEndForm: Invalid request: the end date is required, in YYYY-MM-DD form.
adminOccupancies_residentNotFound: The chosen resident was not found.
adminOccupancies_forbidden: You are not allowed to manage occupancies.
myUnit_subheading: The houses recorded in your name, together with the occupants recorded in them.
myUnit_noRecordBody: Your account is not linked to any resident record in this complex yet. Contact the management to be registered to your house.
myUnit_emptyBody: No occupancy has been recorded in your name yet. Contact the management if that does not match reality.
myUnit_endedNote: Your occupancy of this house has ended, so its current occupants are not shown.
adminPosts_description: The complex's activities and announcements. Drafts are visible only on this page; published posts can be opened by anyone without an account. A post is never deleted, only archived.
adminPosts_empty: No post matches this filter yet.
adminPosts_new_description: A new post is always saved as a draft first. You can preview it and publish it once it has been saved.
adminPosts_form_summaryHint: One or two sentences. This is what appears in the list and in the notification email.
adminPosts_form_bodyHint: Written in Markdown: **bold**, *italic*, lists, links, quotes and tables. Images inside the body are not shown — use the cover image below.
adminPosts_form_eventHint: Only filled in for an activity. An announcement may not have a time or a place.
adminPosts_previewHint: The preview shows the body as a resident reads it. The status does not change.
adminPosts_coverHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 256 KB. Shrink a photo from a phone camera first.
adminPosts_publishedMessage: The post is now on the announcement board.
adminPosts_archivedMessage: The post was archived and no longer appears on the announcement board.
adminPosts_forbidden: You are not allowed to manage posts.
adminPosts_invalidForm: Invalid request: title, summary and body are required.
adminPosts_invalidTime: The start time or the end time could not be read.
adminPosts_transitionRefused: A post with status {from} cannot be moved to {to}.
adminPosts_rule_announcementHasEventTime: An announcement may not have a start time, an end time or a location.
adminPosts_rule_eventNeedsStartTime: An activity needs a start time.
adminPosts_rule_endsBeforeStart: The end time cannot be earlier than the start time.
adminPosts_rule_unknownCategory: That category is not one this application knows.
adminPosts_rule_authorNotRegistered: Your account is not linked to a resident record yet, so a post cannot be attributed to you. Contact a Superuser.
adminPosts_rule_coverImageNotAnImage: That file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
adminPosts_rule_coverImageTooLarge: The cover image is larger than 256 KB.
postPublic_pageDescription: The complex's published activities and announcements, open to anyone without an account.
postPublic_description: Upcoming activities appear first, followed by the latest announcements. Use the filters to see past ones or narrow by category.
postPublic_empty: No activity or announcement matches this filter yet.
postPublic_notFound: This post was not found or has not been published.
adminImport_heading: Import residents from a CSV file
adminImport_description: Fill the register of houses and the people in them in one go. An upload produces a preview first; not a single row is stored before you confirm it.
adminImport_formatHeader: The first line must carry the column titles: blok,nomor,nama,email,peran
adminImport_formatRole: The peran column holds pemilik (owner) or penyewa (tenant).
adminImport_formatLimit: One file carries at most {maximum} data rows.
adminImport_previewNothingSaved: Nothing has been stored yet. Not a single row goes in before you press the confirm button.
adminImport_blockedByProblems: Fix the file first, then upload it again. The import only runs when no row has a problem.
adminImport_importRejected: The import was cancelled and not a single row was stored. This file still carries rows with a problem.
adminImport_missingContent: That preview is gone. Upload the file once more.
adminImport_headerInvalid: The first line of the file must carry the column titles: blok,nomor,nama,email,peran.
adminImport_emptyFile: This file carries no data row at all.
adminImport_tooLarge: This file carries {count} data rows, more than the {maximum} rows one import can write.
adminImport_forbidden: You are not allowed to import resident data.
adminImport_problemMalformedRow: This line does not have five columns.
adminImport_problemInvalidEmail: The email address {value} is not valid.
adminImport_problemUnknownRole: The occupancy role {value} is unknown; write pemilik or penyewa.
adminImport_problemDuplicateUnitInFile: Unit {value} appears more than once in this file.
adminImport_problemDuplicateEmailInFile: The email address {value} appears more than once in this file.
adminImport_problemEmailAlreadyRegistere: The email address {value} already has an account.
adminInvitations_description: Send invitation links to residents' email addresses; they set their own password and are connected to their house right away. The administrators never know anyone's password.
adminInvitations_bulkDescription: Fill in an email address next to each unit you want to invite; empty rows are skipped. Everything is sent together or not at all.
adminInvitations_bulkEmpty: No email address was filled in.
adminInvitations_invalidForm: Invalid request: the unit and the email address have to be filled in correctly.
adminInvitations_alreadyRegistered: The address {email} already has an account that can sign in, so it cannot be invited.
adminInvitations_unitNotFound: The chosen unit was not found.
adminInvitations_resendSuccess: A new invitation was sent to {email}; the old link no longer works.
adminInvitations_resendUsed: That invitation has already been used, so there is nothing to resend.
adminInvitations_empty: No invitation has been sent yet.
adminInvitations_forbidden: You are not allowed to manage invitations.
invitationAccept_unknown: This invitation link is not recognised. Check the link in your email again, or ask the administrators to send a new invitation.
invitationAccept_used: This invitation has already been used and only works once. If it was not you who used it, contact the administrators.
invitationAccept_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the administrators to resend the invitation, then open the link in the new email.
invitationAccept_registered: The email address on this invitation already has an account that can sign in. Just sign in with your password, or recover it on the forgotten-password page.
invitationAccept_unitInfo: You will be recorded as an occupant of block {block} number {number}.
invitationAccept_invalidName: The name has to be filled in.
invitationAccept_passwordTooShort: The password has to be at least {min} characters long.
invitationAccept_passwordMismatch: The two passwords you filled in are not the same.
adminDuesRates_description: The monthly dues amount together with the day it starts applying. A rise agreed at a residents' meeting is scheduled as a new rate; a rate that has already been used to bill can no longer be changed.
adminDuesRates_setSuccess: The rate {amount} effective from {date} was set.
adminDuesRates_editSuccess: The rate was changed to {amount} effective from {date}.
adminDuesRates_deleteSuccess: The rate effective from {date} was deleted.
adminDuesRates_empty: No rate has been set yet.
adminDuesRates_conflict: A rate effective from {date} already exists.
adminDuesRates_inUse: That rate has been used to bill since period {period}, so it can no longer be changed or deleted.
adminDuesRates_wouldClaimBilled: A rate effective from {date} would take period {period} away from the rate that has already used it to bill, so it cannot be set.
adminDuesRates_asOf: The in-force marker is worked out for the day {date}, read in UTC.
adminDuesRates_invalidForm: Invalid request: the amount and the effective date must both be filled in correctly.
adminDuesRates_forbidden: You are not allowed to manage dues rates.
adminCashCategories_description: The classification of every line in the cash book. A category is never deleted, only deactivated, so older transactions keep the category they were filed under.
adminCashCategories_systemNote: A system category is used by another flow in this application, so its name, its type and whether it is active cannot be changed.
adminCashCategories_deactivateSuccess: The category {name} no longer appears when a new transaction is recorded.
adminCashCategories_reactivateSuccess: The category {name} can be used again.
adminCashCategories_inactiveNote: This category does not appear when a new transaction is recorded, but it still shows on the transactions already filed under it.
adminCashCategories_nameTaken: There is already a category named {name}.
adminCashCategories_systemLocked: A system category cannot be renamed, cannot change its type, and cannot be deactivated.
adminCashCategories_invalidForm: Invalid request: the name has to be filled in and the type has to be money in or money out.
adminCashCategories_empty: There is no cash category yet.
adminCashCategories_forbidden: You are not allowed to manage cash categories.
adminOpeningBalance_description: The cash that already existed on the day this application started being used. Recorded once, as a single money-in transaction, so that the running balance matches the money that is really there.
adminOpeningBalance_amountHint: Write it in whole rupiah, for example 1.500.000.
adminOpeningBalance_recordSuccess: The opening balance {amount} was recorded on {date}.
adminOpeningBalance_recordedNote: The opening balance is recorded once and can neither be changed nor removed. If the amount is wrong, the fix is a correcting transaction in the cash book.
adminOpeningBalance_alreadyRecorded: An opening balance has already been recorded, and there is only ever one.
adminOpeningBalance_invalidAmount: The amount has to be a whole-rupiah figure greater than zero, for example 1.500.000.
adminOpeningBalance_invalidForm: Invalid request: the amount and the date have to be filled in.
adminOpeningBalance_forbidden: You are not allowed to record the opening cash balance.
register_reviewNotice: A self-registration still waits for the pengurus to approve it. Once your address is verified you can sign in, but at first you only see the page telling you your registration is under review.
register_claimHint: Write the block and the house number exactly as the sign on your house spells them. The pengurus checks them before your account can be used.
register_claimMissing: The block and the house number have to be filled in.
pendingApproval_pendingBody: The pengurus is still checking your registration. Until it is decided, the other pages of this application are not open to you. You get an email as soon as your registration is approved.
pendingApproval_claim: The house you named: block {block} number {number}.
pendingApproval_rejectedBody: The pengurus turned your registration down for the following reason.
pendingApproval_rejectedNoReason: The pengurus wrote no reason. Get in touch with them if you need an explanation.
pendingApproval_approvedBody: The pengurus approved your registration and attached it to a house.
pendingApproval_noneHeading: No registration in your name yet
pendingApproval_noneBody: Your account is not connected to any resident record and no registration is on file for this address. Register your house, or get in touch with the pengurus if you think this is wrong.
adminRegistrations_description: The registrations waiting for your decision, together with the house each registrant claimed. Approving creates a stay on the unit you pick — which may differ from the one claimed.
adminRegistrations_claimMatched: Matches the unit at block {block} number {number}.
adminRegistrations_claimUnknown: This claimed house matches no unit at all.
adminRegistrations_empty: No registration is waiting for a decision.
adminRegistrations_invalidForm: Invalid request: the registration and the unit both have to be chosen correctly.
adminRegistrations_reasonRequired: Turning a registration down needs a reason the registrant reads.
adminRegistrations_alreadyDecided: That registration has already been decided.
adminRegistrations_accountMissing: No account carries the address {email}, so that registration cannot be approved.
adminRegistrations_unitNotFound: The chosen unit was not found.
adminRegistrations_forbidden: You are not allowed to manage registrations.
adminExemptions_description: A house its owner has left can be exempted from billing from a given date, until a given date or with no end. Granting an exemption never cancels an invoice already issued.
adminExemptions_noUnits: No unit is available to choose yet.
adminExemptions_endedOnLabel: Ends on (optional, leave blank for no end)
adminExemptions_reasonPlaceholder: E.g. house empty since the owner moved out of town
adminExemptions_periodOpen: In force since {startedOn}, with no end yet.
adminExemptions_forbidden: You are not allowed to manage exemptions.
adminExemptions_unitNotFound: The chosen unit was not found.
adminExemptions_invalidForm: Invalid request: the unit, the start date and the reason all have to be filled in correctly.
adminExemptions_dateOrder: The end date {endedOn} cannot be earlier than the start date {startedOn}.
adminExemptions_actorNotRegistered: Your account has no resident record yet, so the exemption cannot be attributed to you.
adminExemptions_overlapOpen: This unit already has an exemption in force since {startedOn} with no end, so this period overlaps it.
adminExemptions_overlapScheduled: This unit already has an exemption in force from {startedOn} to {endedOn}, so this period overlaps it.
adminExemptions_endOverlapOpen: That end date would make this exemption overlap another exemption of the same unit, in force since {startedOn} with no end.
adminExemptions_endOverlapScheduled: That end date would make this exemption overlap another exemption of the same unit, in force from {startedOn} to {endedOn}.
adminCash_description: Every rupiah in and out has a line of its own, dated on the day the money really moved. A line that has been recorded is never changed and never removed; a mistake is put right with a correcting transaction that stays visible.
adminCash_scopeAll: The running balance in the last column is the whole complex's cash balance.
adminCash_scopeMonth: The running balance in the last column is the whole complex's cash balance, starting from the balance at the end of the day before this period.
adminCash_scopeCategory: The running balance in the last column adds up the category {category} alone, so it is not the whole complex's cash balance.
adminCash_scopeMonthAndCategory: The running balance in the last column adds up the category {category} alone, starting from that category's total before this period. It is not the whole complex's cash balance.
adminCash_tableCaption: Cash transactions in date order, with the running balance on every line.
adminCash_empty: No cash transaction matches this filter yet.
adminCash_forbidden: You are not allowed to open the cash book.
adminCash_correctionExplain: A correction adds one reversing line, dated the same day as the transaction it corrects, for the same amount and in the opposite direction. The original line stays and stays visible. A transaction can be corrected once.
adminCash_correctionReasonHint: This reason becomes the correcting line's description and is read by anyone checking the cash book.
adminCash_correctionSuccess: A correction of {amount} was recorded on {date}.
adminCash_correctionAlreadyCorrected: That transaction has already been corrected, and a transaction is corrected once. If the correction itself is wrong, correct the correcting line.
adminCash_correctionInvalidForm: Invalid request: the transaction and the reason both have to be filled in.
adminCash_new_description: One expense, or one income that is not dues. Its date is when the money really moved, not when this line was typed. Once recorded, this line can neither be changed nor removed.
adminCash_new_noCategories: There is no usable cash category yet. Ask a superuser to add one first.
adminCash_form_categoryHint: The type of the category you pick decides whether this transaction is money in or money out.
adminCash_form_amountHint: Write it in whole rupiah, for example 1.500.000. The amount is always greater than zero; the category decides the direction.
adminCash_form_descriptionHint: What the money was for. A description is required so that this line can be checked later.
adminCash_form_receiptHint: A JPEG, PNG or WebP file of at most 256 KB. The receipt can only be opened through a short-lived signed link from this page.
adminCash_invalidForm: Invalid request: the date, the category, the amount and the description all have to be filled in.
adminCash_invalidAmount: The amount has to be a whole-rupiah figure greater than zero, for example 1.500.000.
adminCash_rule_categoryIsSystem: A system category accepts no manual entry. Money in on "Iuran warga" only comes from verifying a payment, and the opening balance is recorded on its own page.
adminCash_rule_categoryRetired: That category has been deactivated, so a new transaction cannot be filed under it.
adminCash_rule_amountNotPositive: The amount has to be greater than zero. Whether this is money in or money out is decided by the category, not by a minus sign.
adminCash_rule_notACalendarDay: That date is not a day that exists on the calendar.
adminCash_rule_descriptionMissing: A description is required. On a correction, that description is its reason.
adminCash_rule_receiptTooLarge: The receipt photo is too large. The limit is 256 KB.
adminCash_rule_receiptNotAnImage: The receipt photo has to be a JPEG, PNG or WebP file that really is an image.
adminPeriods_description: Every month of the cash book is either open or locked. A month whose monthly report has been published is locked, and transactions dated inside it are refused until a superuser reopens it with a reason.
adminPeriods_empty: No periods yet. A period appears on its own when the first transaction of that month is recorded.
adminPeriods_notYetCreated: This month has no period row yet, so it is open.
adminPeriods_noReports: No monthly report has been published for this period yet.
adminPeriods_unlockExplain: Unlocking lets transactions dated inside this month be recorded again. The reason goes to the audit log and cannot be removed.
adminPeriods_unlockReasonHint: Say what makes this month need reopening, for example a receipt that has only just turned up.
adminPeriods_invalidForm: The form is incomplete. Pick the period and write a reason.
adminPeriods_forbidden: You are not allowed to open the cash book periods page.
adminPeriods_rule_notACalendarMonth: That is not a month on the calendar.
adminPeriods_rule_reasonMissing: A reason is required. That reason is what goes to the audit log.
adminPeriods_rule_alreadyOpen: That period is not locked, so there is nothing to unlock.
adminComplaints_description: Every complaint that is not yet finished, longest wait first.
adminComplaints_forbidden: You are not allowed to see the complaint work queue.
adminComplaints_staleBadge: Hanging for more than seven days
adminComplaints_ageLabel: Waiting {days} days since its last status change.
adminComplaintDetail_forbidden: You are not allowed to see this complaint.
adminComplaintDetail_invalidForm: Invalid request: the target status was not recognised.
adminComplaintDetail_transitionRefused: A complaint in status {from} cannot move to {to}.
adminComplaintDetail_rule_rejectionNeeds: Rejecting a complaint needs a reason the reporter can read.
adminComplaintDetail_rule_reasonWithoutR: A reason is only entered when rejecting a complaint.
adminComplaintDetail_rule_visibilityOnly: A complaint's visibility can only move from public to private.
adminComplaintDetail_rule_actorNotRegist: Your account is not yet recorded as a resident, so it cannot be attributed to this complaint.
adminComplaintDetail_rule_replyContentRe: A reply must not be empty.
invoices_subheading: Your house's invoices, and how much is still owed.
invoices_emptyBody: Your house has no invoice visible here yet.
adminOverdue_description: Houses with an invoice that is unpaid and past its due date, largest total overdue first.
adminOverdue_forbidden: You are not allowed to see the overdue houses list.
adminOverdueUnit_empty: This house has never had an invoice.
adminOverdueUnit_forbidden: You are not allowed to see this house's invoice history.
payments_description: The payments you have recorded, with their status. Money only reaches the cash book once a pengurus has verified it.
payments_recordedNotice: Your payment has been recorded and is waiting for a pengurus to verify it.
payments_noUnit: You are not recorded as living in any house yet, so there is nothing to pay for. Contact a pengurus if that is wrong.
payments_emptyBody: Once you have transferred your dues, record it here with a photo of the receipt so a pengurus can verify it.
payments_cancelSuccess: The {amount} payment was cancelled and its record removed.
payments_invalidForm: The form is incomplete. Fill in the house, the amount, the day the money was transferred, and the photo of the receipt.
payments_invalidAmount: The amount must be whole rupiah, for example 150000 or 150.000. Fractions are not accepted.
payments_rule_amountNotPositive: The amount must be greater than zero.
payments_rule_notACalendarDay: That date is not a day on the calendar.
payments_rule_receivedInTheFuture: That transfer date has not arrived yet. Enter the day the money actually moved.
payments_rule_proofMissing: A photo of the transfer receipt is required.
payments_rule_proofTooLarge: The proof photo is too large. The limit is {maximumSize} MB.
payments_rule_proofNotAnImage: The proof must be a JPEG, PNG or WebP file that really is an image.
payments_rule_alreadyDecided: A pengurus has already decided on that payment, so it can no longer be cancelled.
payments_new_description: Tell the pengurus that you have transferred the money. It only reaches the cash book once they have verified it.
payments_new_noUnit: You are not recorded as living in any house yet, so there is nothing to pay for. Contact a pengurus if that is wrong.
payments_form_invoicesEmpty: This house has no dues issued yet. You can still pay in advance: just enter the amount.
payments_form_invoicesHint: Ticking dues only fills in the amount below. A pengurus decides which dues the money settles when they verify it, oldest first.
payments_form_amountHint: Whole rupiah, for example {example}. Leave every tick box empty if you are paying in advance.
payments_form_receivedOnHint: The day the money actually moved, not the day you fill in this form.
payments_form_proofHint: A JPEG, PNG or WebP file, at most {maximumSize} MB. You can take it straight from your phone camera. The proof can only be opened through a short-lived signed link.
payments_form_proofTooLarge: That file is {size} MB, over the {maximumSize} MB limit. Choose a smaller photo.
adminPayments_description: The queue of payments waiting for a decision, oldest first. Verifying records the money into the cash book on the day it was received and settles invoices starting from the oldest.
adminPayments_empty: No payments are waiting for verification.
adminPayments_invoicesHint: Without a tick, allocation runs automatically from the oldest unpaid invoice. Ticked invoices are settled first; the rest still runs from the oldest, and anything left over becomes the unit's credit balance.
adminPayments_noOpenInvoices: This unit has no open invoices; the whole amount becomes its credit balance.
adminPayments_verifySuccess: The payment of {amount} is verified. The money is recorded in the cash book on {date}.
adminPayments_rejectSuccess: The payment was rejected. The resident will read the reason you wrote.
adminPayments_invalidForm: The form is incomplete. Reload the queue and try again.
adminPayments_notFound: That payment no longer exists — the resident may have withdrawn it. Reload the queue.
adminPayments_periodLocked: Period {period} is locked, so money dated {date} cannot be recorded yet. Ask a superuser to unlock it first.
adminPayments_forbidden: You are not allowed to verify payments.
adminPayments_rule_alreadyDecided: That payment has already been decided. Reload the queue.
adminPayments_rule_actorNotRegistered: Your account is not recorded as a resident yet, so the verification cannot be attributed. Contact a superuser.
adminPayments_rule_reasonMissing: A rejection needs a reason the resident will read.
adminPayments_rule_unknownInvoiceSelecte: One of the ticked invoices is no longer open. Reload the queue.
adminPayments_rule_amountNotPositive: The amount must be greater than zero.
adminPayments_rule_notACalendarDay: That date is not a day on the calendar.
adminPayments_rule_receivedInTheFuture: The day the money was received has not arrived. Enter a day that has already happened.
adminPayments_cash_description: A payment handed over to the pengurus in person. The moment it is recorded it is verified: the money enters the cash book on the day it was received, and the oldest invoices are settled first.
adminPayments_cash_noUnits: There is no active unit to record a payment for yet.
adminPayments_cash_amountHint: Whole rupiah, for example 150000 or 150.000. Fractional cents are not accepted.
adminPayments_cash_success: The cash payment of {amount} was recorded and verified on the spot.
adminPayments_cash_invalidForm: The form is incomplete. Fill in the unit, the amount, and the day the money was received.
adminPayments_cash_invalidAmount: The amount must be whole rupiah, for example 150000 or 150.000. Fractional cents are not accepted.
reports_description: Every report is produced from the cash book rather than typed out again. Its figures are frozen when it is published, so a report you have already read never changes quietly. If a receipt turns up late, a pengurus publishes a numbered revision with its reason, and the older revision stays readable.
reports_empty: No monthly report has been published yet.
reports_notFound: That monthly report was not found.
reports_detail_backLink: Back to the list of reports
reports_summary_notLatest: This is not the newest revision. The figures that apply now are on the newest revision of this month.
reports_summary_duesCollected: Dues collected for this month's bills
reports_summary_duesCollectedHint: How much of this month's bills has been settled, whenever the money arrived.
reports_summary_duesCashIn: Dues cash received during this month
reports_summary_duesCashInHint: Dues money that actually arrived inside this month, including settlements of earlier months' bills. These two figures really are different, and both are shown so that your own addition adds up.
reports_summary_duesUnitsUnpaid: Houses not yet paid in full
reports_summary_duesPrivacy: The dues summary is nothing but counts. This report carries no name and no house number.
reports_categories_caption: Every category with its total for the month this report covers.
reports_categories_incomeEmpty: There was no income this month.
reports_categories_expenseEmpty: There were no expenses this month.
reports_categories_drilldownClosedHint: The dues category is not broken down, because one line of it is one house's payment. Its total and its summary are above.
reports_drilldown_caption: This category's transactions in the month the report covers, in date order.
reports_drilldown_liveIncome: Income in the cash book right now: {amount}
reports_drilldown_liveExpense: Expenses in the cash book right now: {amount}
reports_drilldown_changed: This month's cash book changed after this revision was published, so the totals below no longer match the published ones. The published figures still stand for this revision; the change will appear in the next one.
reports_drilldown_empty: This category has no transaction in the month the report covers.
adminReports_description: Preview any month's figures at any time, then publish once they are right. Publishing freezes the figures, numbers the revision and locks the month, in one step.
adminReports_previewNote: This is a preview, not a published report. Its figures are worked out again every time this page is opened, and are only frozen when you publish.
adminReports_publishExplain: Publishing freezes the figures above, numbers them revision {revision}, and locks {period}. Once the month is locked, a cash transaction dated inside it is refused until a superuser reopens the month with a reason.
adminReports_reasonHint: Required from revision 2 on, and shown to every resident. Say what changed since the previous revision.
adminReports_lockedNote: {period} is already locked by a published report, so there is nothing to publish right now. To publish a revision, ask a superuser to reopen that month first.
adminReports_revisionsEmpty: This month has never been published.
adminReports_publishSuccess: The {period} report was published as revision {revision}, and that month is now locked.
adminReports_invalidForm: That request is not valid: a month is written as YYYY-MM.
adminReports_forbidden: You are not allowed to publish a monthly report.
adminReports_rule_revisionReasonMissing: Revision 2 and onwards must carry a reason, because residents have already read the earlier figures.
adminReports_rule_revisionReasonNotAllow: Revision 1 revises nothing, so it may not carry a reason for a revision.
adminReports_periodRule_notACalendarMont: That is not a month on the calendar.
adminReports_periodRule_reasonMissing: Locking a month always records a reason, and this one is empty.
adminReports_periodRule_alreadyLocked: That month is already locked by a published report. Ask a superuser to reopen it first, then publish the revision.
complaints_description: The complaints you reported, with their status and how long they have been waiting.
complaints_mineEmpty: You have not reported any complaint yet.
complaints_publicEmpty: No complaint is marked public yet.
complaints_ageLabel: Waiting {days} days since its last status change.
